MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick feels useful because it could add streaming to my existing TV, provided the connections work; my 720p screen gives me little reason to prefer the 4K version.",
    "The memory card bundle connects with my repeated storage purchases. More capacity could help if the card works with my devices, although the included reader duplicates something I already own."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and displays do not meet a current need. Owning a Fire tablet does not mean I want voice control or another screen.",
    "My car accessories help mount and power devices; they do not indicate that I want Alexa in the car. Likewise, buying power strips does not mean I want home automation.",
    "The WYZE camera serves home monitoring, while my tripods, film, and lens cap relate to photography. Sharing the word camera does not make it useful for the same purpose."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as broad interest in Amazon devices, even though most of these products serve different needs.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as interest in connected gadgets generally, rather than equipment and accessories with specific practical uses."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters: memory cards must work with my devices, and a streaming stick must connect to my TV. Extra capabilities alone do not make something a better fit.",
    "What I already own matters. Another card reader needs a clear benefit, while accessories that support my existing photography, storage, and mounting equipment feel more relevant."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly understood my storage and TV needs but stretched my device purchases into an interest in Alexa and home automation that I have not shown."
}
